resources.text: In the land of vengeful spirits where gray fog drifts all year round and cold winds howl, there lies a soul that makes one's heart ache.

She used to be an innocent little girl who loved to tie her hair in pigtails, chase butterflies, and listen to bedtime stories. She should have had a sunny, flower - filled, and carefree childhood. However, a sudden serious illness clung to her. High fever, pain, and weakness tortured her tiny body day and night. She cried and shouted, but no one could truly pull her out of the pain.
In the end, the little girl closed her eyes forever, filled with endless grievances, unwillingness, and a heart full of resentment.
Her soul didn't head towards the bright cycle of reincarnation. Instead, it was wrapped in thick resentment and transformed into a little vengeful spirit witch.

Eyes open, pupils contracting into vertical slits: Her soul didn't head towards the bright cycle of reincarnation. Instead, it was wrapped in thick resentment and transformed into a little vengeful spirit witch.
Turning to face the thorny path, raising a hand to wipe away tears: She hates the cold illness and the world that failed to save her. She madly swears in her heart:
I will become the supreme ghost king! I will make the whole world experience the pain I've endured! Let everyone be haunted by illness!

With this paranoid and crazy wish, the little witch wipes away her tears, steps out of the land of vengeful spirits, and embarks on the path of the ghost king, a path full of tests, choices, and redemption.

Dear young readers, from now on, you are the guide for the little witch! At every fork in the road, you need to help her make a choice. Right or wrong, good or evil, light or dark, it's all up to you!
As soon as the little witch steps out of the land of vengeful spirits, the gray mist rushes towards her, and two completely different paths immediately appear in front of her.
One small path is dim and quiet, with a faint smell of ghosts floating around; the other small path is shining with golden light, piled with glittering treasures, extremely tempting.
I want to become stronger! I want to be the ghost king! But... which path should I take?
Biting her lips, slowly turning her head from left to right, her gaze shifting between the two paths: But... which path should I take?
You can take either path! One is to fight monsters and accumulate experience, the other is to steal treasures and get rich quickly!
I... which one should I choose after all?

branches.label: Defeat the cold ghost and accumulate experience
Be greedy for wealth and steal treasures

resources.text: Its huge body leans forward slightly, the miasma around it surges violently, and virus particles spread around.
I can't be impatient! I'll become stronger step by step! I choose to defeat the cold ghost!
Reaching out her right hand forward, pointing into the depths of the mist: I choose to defeat the cold ghost!
Great! Starting with a down - to - earth attitude is the most correct way!
The little witch walks forward along the dim path. After just a few steps, she hears a continuous series of sneezing sounds.
A cold ghost wrapped in a thick quilt with a red nose is huddled beside a rock, constantly running at the nose.
Achoo — Achoo — Who... who's there? Achoo!
I'm the little witch who will become the ghost king! I'm going to defeat you!
Just... just you, a little thing? Achoo — I'm not afraid!
Take my resentment blast!
The little witch stretches out her small hand, and a weak but determined black resentment strikes out.
The cold ghost, already weak all over, is knocked to the ground at once.
I give up... I give up... Achoo — You're so powerful!
Yeah! I won! I've gained experience! I've officially started my journey to level up!
Congratulations, little witch! Keep going! More challenging tests are waiting for you!
After successfully defeating the Cold Ghost, the little witch felt as light as a feather. Her magic power was several times stronger than before.
She continued walking forward. Two choices appeared again on the way ahead: Should she press on and continue to challenge the ghosts, or rest in place and eat to regain her strength?
The battle just now was so tiring... But I still want to level up quickly...
If you continue to fight, you can become stronger faster; if you stop to rest, you can regain your strength. Which one do you choose?

branches.label: Press on and challenge the Disabled Ghost
Rest in place and replenish your strength

resources.text: Wow! It's a treasure! So many shiny gold and gems! I'm going to steal them!
Don't go over there! The treasure is surrounded by deadly traps!
I don't care about any traps! I want to be rich! I want to become stronger as soon as possible!
She tiptoed and quietly slipped into the treasure area. As soon as her little hand touched the most dazzling gold coin.
"Whoosh --!"
Suddenly, a purple - glowing poisoned needle shot out from the ground and stabbed hard into the little witch's arm!
Ah --! It hurts! It hurts so much! What is this thing!
The toxin starts to spread... The strength starts to drain...
My body... It's so numb... I can't stand up... Wuwuwu...
I told you there were traps... Greed comes at a price.
[Failure triggered: Return to the main line and make a new choice]

branches.label: Defeat the Cold Ghost and accumulate experience

resources.text: I can't stop! I'm going to press on! I'm going to challenge the Disabled Ghost!
Brave child! Go ahead!
The little witch followed the ghost's aura and soon found a Disabled Ghost who was walking with a stick and had difficulty moving.
The Disabled Ghost looked fierce, but it didn't attack actively.
Little girl, do you really want to fight me? I won't show any mercy.
I want to become the Ghost King! I must defeat you!
Okay! Then I'll see what you're capable of!
The little witch mobilized the resentment power she had just improved and launched a steady attack without any impatience.
After a fierce fight, the Disabled Ghost was successfully defeated!
"Ding --!"
A bright light envelops the little witch, and her level directly jumps to level 5. Her power surges instantly!
Level 5! I've reached level 5! My power has become so strong!
You really have the potential to become the Ghost King... Come on, little girl.
Thank you! I'll keep working hard!
Looking at the experience light shining on her body, her pupils dilate and the corners of her mouth gradually turn up: Yeah! I won! I've gained experience!
Jumping up happily, raising her arms high and spinning her body: I've officially started my upgrading journey!
Floating around and circling the little witch, clapping hands non - stop: Congratulations, little witch! Keep going!
Standing firm after landing, making a fist and pointing to the road ahead, with a burning look in her eyes: A more powerful test is waiting for you!
The little witch who has reached level 5 is full of strength. She strides forward and walks into a vast expanse of white mist.
As she walks, two familiar figures suddenly run over - one is an old friend she hasn't seen for a long time, and the other is her former close - by bestie!
Little witch! It's me! Long time no see! Come with me quickly! I'll show you a shortcut!
Don't believe him! Something's wrong with him! Come with me! I'll always protect you!
I... Who should I believe? They were both the closest people to me before!

branches.label: Choose to trust the bestie and go with her

resources.text: Side quest: Rest in place and replenish energy
So tired! I need to rest! I need to eat to replenish energy!
Eat me! I'm so sweet and delicious! You'll be fully recovered right after eating me!
Wow! It looks so delicious! I want to eat!
She picks up the fruit and takes big bites. The fruit is sweet and juicy. It tastes wonderful.
But not long after swallowing it, a sharp pain suddenly comes from her stomach!
Ouch... My stomach... It hurts so much... What's going on!
Hahaha! This is a fruit poisoned with a deadly toxin! You've been tricked!
My power... is disappearing quickly... My level... is dropping... Wuwuwu...
Greedy and lazy people always encounter danger!
[Failure triggered: Return to the main line and make a new choice]

branches.label: Seize the opportunity to pursue and challenge the disabled ghost

resources.text: Old friend! It's really you! I miss you so much! I'll go with you!
Good girl... Come with me...
The little witch follows the "old friend" into the depths of the mist without any defense.
Suddenly, the "old friend" emitted a blinding light, and its body began to twist and deform!
A slender body and a glowing head - it was actually an imposter transformed from a beauty laser device!
Ah? You're not my friend! What on earth are you!
Stupid little girl! You're too easy to trust others! I'm going to devour you!
Nooo --! Help!
The imposter opened its huge beam mouth and swallowed the defenseless little witch whole. The little witch instantly disappeared into the mist.
[Trigger failed: Return to the main line and make a new choice]

branches.label: Choose to trust your best friend and go together

resources.text: I trust you! Best friend! I choose to go with you!
Great! I knew you'd trust me! I'll never hurt you!
The two held hands and walked forward together. The best friend was familiar with the paths in the mist and always led the little witch to avoid danger.
Moreover, the best friend shared a part of her magic power that she had cultivated for many years with the little witch.
"Ding --!"
The little witch's level directly increased by 2 levels, and her strength became even stronger!
Wow! I've become stronger again! Thank you, best friend! I feel so safe with you!
We're the best partners. We should rely on and help each other. But you have to remember, even if you have resentment in your heart, don't lose yourself.
I remember! Let's work hard together!
The little witch and her best friend walked side by side for a long time. Both of them were out of breath and had fine beads of sweat on their foreheads.

They stopped by the roadside to rest. There were two kinds of fruits in front of them: one was an ordinary, bright - red strawberry; the other was a golden apple that emitted a strong magic power and was extremely alluring.
Little witch, choose the red strawberry! It's gentle and safe, with no side effects, and can help you level up steadily.
Choose me! Choose me! Eat me, and you'll instantly become super strong! You'll reach the top in one step!
I want to become stronger as fast as possible... I want to become the Ghost King soon... But my best friend said the red strawberry is safer... Which one should I choose?

branches.label: Eat the red strawberry and level up steadily
Eat the golden apple and force an advancement

resources.text: I can't be greedy for quick strength! I'll take it step by step! I choose to eat the red strawberry!
Great! You've made the smartest choice!
Don't worry and eat! I'll gently enhance your magic power!
The little witch picked up the red strawberry and took a small bite.
It was sweet and sour, melting in the mouth. A gentle and comfortable magic power slowly flowed through her whole body without any pain.
"Ding --!"
Successfully reached level 7, with magic power steadily increasing and no discomfort in the body!
So warm! I've become stronger, but I don't feel any pain at all! This feeling is amazing!
See! Impatience and greed only bring danger. Taking it step by step is the right way.
I won't be impatient anymore! I'll become stronger slowly!
After the rest, the magic power is fully restored. The little witch hugs her best friend tightly and says goodbye.
You have to work hard! I believe you can become the best ghost king! Don't lose yourself!
Thank you! Best friend! I'll definitely remember your words!
After saying goodbye to her best friend, the little witch heads towards the Ghost King's Hall alone.
The closer she gets to the hall, the more oppressive the atmosphere becomes. She knows that the Ghost King is extremely powerful and she must make full preparations.
At this moment, she faces the final pre - battle choice: should she first look for the secret manual and proceed steadily, or take the risk to challenge the cancer ghost for a quick upgrade?
The Ghost King is so strong and scary... How on earth should I prepare?
Get the secret manual and have a steady battle; challenge the cancer ghost and achieve a great leap. Two paths, two fates. You choose for yourself.

branches.label: Get the secret manual and fight the Ghost King
Challenge the cancer ghost and upgrade quickly

resources.text: I want to become stronger as fast as possible! I want to upgrade directly! I choose to eat the golden apple!
Don't eat it! Little witch! That thing is very dangerous! It'll ruin you!
I don't care! I want to be the Ghost King! I want to have powerful strength right away!
She grabs the golden apple and swallows it in one big bite!
As soon as she swallows it, a wild and extremely powerful magic power suddenly explodes inside her body!
"Boom —!"
A huge black hole cracks open on the ground, and a powerful suction force instantly pulls the little witch into it!
Ah —! Where is this! Help! I'm so scared!
Smash the mind... Smash the power... Erase the consciousness...
My head... is so messy... My power... is disappearing... I... I can't remember anything...
The black hole slowly closes, and the little witch completely disappears into the darkness.
[Trigger failure: Return to the main line and make the choice again]

branches.label: Eat red strawberries and upgrade steadily

resources.text: I can't take risks! The Ghost King is too powerful. I must make full preparations! I choose to get the secret manual first.
A wise choice...
Following the guidance, the little witch comes to a hidden cave. An old man with white hair, the guardian of the secret manual, is sitting in the cave.
Child, I know what you're here for. You're calm and determined, and you deserve this secret manual.
Thank you! I'll use it to do the right thing!
This is the "Technique of Resentment Protection". It can not only enhance your power but also help you keep your true self. Take it.
The little witch took the secret manual and practiced seriously. Her power became stable, strong, and gentle.
After finishing her practice, she took a deep breath and strode into the Ghost King's Hall!
Ghost King! I'm here to challenge you! I'm going to be the new Ghost King!
Holding the "Technique of Resentment Protection", the little witch engaged in an earth - shattering battle with the old Ghost King in the Ghost King's Hall.
Relying on the power of the secret manual, she kept her true self, remained calm, and every move was full of power but not violent.
After three days and three nights of fighting, the old Ghost King was finally defeated and fell to the ground!
The black Ghost King's crown fell from the old Ghost King's head and landed firmly on the little witch's head!
She succeeded! She defeated the Ghost King and ascended to the supreme position of the Ghost King!
She slowly stood up, clenched her fists, and turned to face the wilderness.
She strode out of the boundary of the Ghost Land, with her cloak fluttering in the wind.
As she stepped out of the Ghost Land, the gray mist rushed towards her.
But just then, a fierce battle broke out in her heart!
On one side, there was the voice of resentment, shouting crazily to take revenge on the world; on the other side, there was the voice of kindness, gently reminding her not to hurt the innocent.
The two voices kept arguing in her mind, causing her great pain.
Have you forgotten the suffering you've endured? Make the whole world sick! Let everyone feel your pain! Take revenge on the world!
Don't do this... The pain you've suffered shouldn't be borne by the innocent. True strength lies in protection, not harm.
Her head suddenly tilted to the left, her left eye wide open and bloodshot, her right eye closed: on one side, the voice of resentment was shouting crazily to take revenge on the world.

Her head then suddenly tilted to the right, her right eye wide open with tears streaming down, her left eye closed: on one side, the voice of kindness was gently reminding her not to hurt the innocent.

Kneeling on the ground, looking up at the sky, with her hands stretched out desperately to the sides, her body being torn by an invisible force and swaying from side to side: the two voices kept arguing in her mind, causing her great pain.
The Medicine King, wearing white clothes and holding herbs, slowly appeared.
Little witch, you're already the Ghost King. Now, make the most important choice of your life. What kind of Ghost King do you want to be?

branches.label: Become a bad Ghost King and take revenge on the world.
Become a good Ghost King and protect the world.

resources.text: Defeating the Cancer Ghost can directly raise your level by 10! I'm going to take a gamble! I want to become the Ghost King as soon as possible!
Impatience will bring destruction... You'll regret it...
Ignoring the dissuasion, the little witch went straight to the Cancer Ghost's lair.
A huge Cancer Ghost, exuding a dark aura all over its body, was coiled in the center of the lair, with an extremely oppressive presence.
Tiny girl... You're too weak... You're no match for me...
I'm not afraid of you! I'll defeat you! I'll level up!
The battle is about to break out!
The Cancer Ghost just waved its claws gently, and the powerful dark force made the little witch gasp for breath.
The little witch fought with all her might, but she couldn't hold out at all!
So strong... Too strong... I... I can't beat it at all...
Go back... You're not qualified to be the Ghost King yet... Come back when you're truly powerful.
The little witch was covered in injuries and had exhausted her magic. She couldn't stand up anymore.
[Trigger failed: Return to the main line and make a new choice]

branches.label: Obtain the secret manual and fight the Ghost King in a decisive battle

resources.text: I hate! I hate so much! I'll take revenge! I'll become the evil Ghost King! I'll make the whole world suffer from illness!
Release the darkness... Spread the illness... Destroy everything...
The little witch mobilized all the dark power in her body and was ready to release the curse of illness to the whole world!
Just then, a golden light suddenly shone in the sky!
The Justice Virus Legion assembled neatly. Their shields glistened and their weapons glowed as they charged towards the evil witch!
Evil will never prevail over justice! You'll never hurt innocent people!
Don't try to stop me! I'll make everyone taste my pain!
All attack! Purify the evil together!
Countless rays of justice hit the little witch. The resentment on her body was gradually purified, and her body became transparent little by little.
No —! My resentment! My power! Don't disappear!
Resentment will only destroy yourself. Only kindness can achieve eternity.
The little witch's body became fainter and fainter. Finally, she completely vanished into thin air and never appeared again.

branches.label: Choose to be a good Ghost King

resources.text: I... I don't want others to suffer... I don't want anyone else to be tortured by illness like me and leave with regrets...
You've made the bravest and greatest choice. A true Ghost King doesn't rule the world with fear but protects it with love.
The pupils contracted, and the line of sight shifted between the Medicine King and the void
Took a half - step back and spread out the arms. The herbs turned into light spots and dissipated
Hugged the head and knelt on the ground. The body trembled violently, and the knuckles turned white from exertion: Have you forgotten the pain you've suffered? Make the whole world sick!
I'll let go of my resentment! I'll become a good Ghost King! I'll protect this world! I'll make the illness disappear! Let everyone be healthy and happy!
She took off the cold Ghost King's crown on her head and transformed the dark resentment in her body into warm healing light.
She walked up to the Medicine King on her own initiative, reached out her little hand, and shook hands tightly with the Medicine King.
My lord Medicine King, I want to be with you! Let's stand side by side, drive away illnesses together, and protect all lives!
Welcome, the new Guardian Ghost King! From now on, let's protect the peace of the world together!
The healing light illuminated the entire land of evil spirits. The gray mist dispersed, and the sunlight shone down.
The illnesses were suppressed, the viruses were dispelled, and all suffering lives were redeemed.
From today on, I'm no longer the resentful demoness bent on revenge! I'm the kind - hearted Ghost King who guards the world! I'll use my power to protect everyone!
The world has become warmer and more beautiful because of your choice.
Long live the good Ghost King! Long live the kind - hearted Ghost King!
The adventure was a complete success! You used kindness and reason to save the little demoness and the whole world!
Slowly raising her head, tears slid down her cheeks but floated in mid - air. Her lips trembled slightly as she opened them: "True strength lies in protection, not harm."
